title: Find First Repeated Character
description: Given a string, find the first character that appears more than once. If no character is repeated, indicate that no repeated character exists.
input: A string in which the first repeated character needs to be found.
output: The first character that is repeated in the string. If no character is repeated, indicate that no repeated character exists.

examples.explanation: The character 's' appears again after its first occurrence, making it the first repeated character.
The character 'l' is the first character encountered whose second occurrence is found.
The character 'a' appears more than once and is the first repeated character.
Every character occurs only once, so there is no repeated character.

constraints: The input must be a valid string.

approaches.name: Using HashSet
approaches.description: Traverse the string from left to right and store each character in a HashSet. If a character is already present in the set, it is the first repeated character.
approaches.whenToUse: Use when you need to find the first repeated character efficiently while traversing the string once.

interviewTips: Understand why a HashSet is useful for detecting duplicates.
Traverse the string from left to right to preserve the required order.
The first character already present in the set is the first repeated character.
Be prepared to explain the time and space complexity.
